## Description

Combines a call, put, underlying and financing position to exploit deviations from put-call parity after dividends, rates and borrow costs.

## Where it may fit

Rare, short-lived mispricing in liquid European-style or appropriately adjusted American option markets.

## Vehicles

Options market makers and proprietary derivatives desks.

## Required data

Synchronized call/put bid-ask quotes at same strike/expiry, underlying, rates, dividends, borrow costs, exercise style and settlement terms.

## Caveats

American exercise, discrete dividends, early assignment, funding and legging risk complicate textbook parity; use executable multi-leg prices.
